messages:
laura_cs: Heads-up — AC-472 reporting a month-end mismatch. Dashboard tokens = 12,300, final invoice tokens = 10,200. ~$200 delta. Customer asking why totals differ. Screenshot: https://redwood.example/snap/AC-472-02-28.png

michael_billing: Can you paste account id + invoice id + billing period so I can pull ledger?

laura_cs: Account: AC-472, Invoice: INV-2024-02-28-AC472, period: 2024-02-01 -> 2024-02-28. Note: plan changed mid-cycle (Pro -> Enterprise) on 2024-02-15.

dean_finance: I pulled the invoice. There's a suppressed ledger line: "reserved-burst-credit" with amt 0 that our finalizer flagged as proration-negative and collapsed. That explains the missing token row.

dean_finance: snippet of what I ran:
```sql
SELECT l.id, l.type, l.tokens, l.amount, l.suppressed_reason
FROM invoice_lines l
WHERE l.invoice_id = 'INV-2024-02-28-AC472';
```

anya_eng: Possible sources: meter-ingest dup, finalizer suppression logic, or plan-change proration logic. Can we check raw token stream for AC-472 and compare to invoice_lines aggregation? Run quick join:
```sql
SELECT sum(r.tokens) as raw_tokens, sum(i.tokens) as invoiced_tokens
FROM raw_metering r
LEFT JOIN invoice_lines i ON r.account_id = i.account_id AND date_trunc('day', r.ts) = date_trunc('day', i.day)
WHERE r.account_id = 'AC-472' AND r.ts BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-28';
```

reconcile-bot: Invoice finalization job finished: job_id=finalize-20240228-17:32, suppressed_lines=1, warnings=["negative_proration_overlap"].

michael_billing: @dean can you confirm whether suppression happens before taxes/credits calc? Customer will want explanation + fix.
dean_finance: Suppression happens during finalizer pass before credits. In this case the finalizer saw overlap: new plan entitlement because of mid-cycle upgrade + an old reserved burst credit that produced negative proration, it marked the line suppressed to avoid negative line items.

anya_eng: I repro'd on staging by replaying raw_metering for AC-472. Staging invoice shows raw and invoiced tokens matching ~12,298 (close to dashboard). Production finalizer logic is removing the positive usage line due to proration rule.

michael_billing: Ok — sounds like finalizer bug. Dean, can you re-run finalize with debug on INV-2024-02-28-AC472 and capture diff?
\
dean_finance: Re-ran with debug flag. Found finalizer applied `proration_override=true` when overlapping upgrade had trial=false but entitlement_start earlier. Actionable bug: finalizer was collapsing lines where proration_result < 0 even if there were positive usage tokens attached. Raised PR #5231 to stop collapsing positive usage rows and instead emit zeroed-credit + explanatory note.

laura_cs: Nice. For the customer: do we refund or issue credit? They already paid invoice.
\
michael_billing: We'll issue a credit equal to the delta and attach a credit note referencing INV-2024-02-28-AC472. I'll prepare draft and ops can apply to next invoice or refund on request.
\
laura_cs: Please CC me on the credit note. I'll update the customer and include explanation that we found an invoice finalizer suppression bug tied to mid-cycle plan upgrade. :white_check_mark:
\
dean_finance: Deploying PR #5231 to staging for validation. Will schedule hotfix to prod after smoke tests. ETA 4 hours.
\
anya_eng: For postmortem — add automated check: compare raw_metering daily sum vs invoice_lines daily sum at finalize and alert if delta > 1%. I'll open a ticket.
\
michael_billing: Thanks team. I'll send the credit note and follow up with customer. Laura — can you paste customer reply here when you get it?
\
laura_cs: Will do. Thanks everyone. :pray:
